title: EntityTypeList
description: NGSI-LD EntityTypeList data type (ETSI GS CIM 009 clause 5.2.24). The entity type list representation returned by GET /types (clause 4.5.10). Not subject to options=concise/keyValues.

id.description: URI that is unique within the system scope. Identifier for the entity type list.

type.description: JSON-LD @type. It shall be equal to "EntityTypeList".

typeList.description: List containing the entity type names.
